title: Agentic Security Operations Platform Configurations by Outegration

blocks.text: The Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) supports outegrations from third parties and from Zscaler. These outegrations dispatch tickets, trigger scans, update CMDB records, export reports to external platforms, and send email notifications. Use this article to identify the available outegrations, the category each one belongs to, the actions each one performs, and whether it supports webhook configuration for bidirectional sync. For deployment prerequisites and setup steps, see Deploying Outegration Configurations. To configure a specific outegration, see Outegration Configuration Guides.
The following table lists the supported third-party outegrations in alphabetical order by vendor. If an outegration supports bidirectional sync, the corresponding webhook guide is listed.

table: Publishes entity data and ticket events to an external Kafka topic.
